trailhead.label: The Sentiero dei Gufi board, Via Roma, Venaus, the board’s start

cautions: A short road crossing by the cemetery: keep your dog on a short lead there.
The upper part is a mountain path (T2) for a short way: watch your dog’s footing on loose stones.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
